# Ask the Model support

## Application or build problem

Use the **Bug / application problem** issue form. Include the AtM version, installation method, environment, exact steps and relevant output.

## Provider or model compatibility

Use the **Provider / model compatibility** form when the issue involves provider discovery, model listing/capability filtering, model registration or streamed chat behavior.

## Repository grounding, retrieval or provenance

Use the **Repository / grounding / provenance** form when the problem involves:

- EWD/CBD/RMD Refresh or Download/Update;
- repository READY/offline/error state;
- snapshot/index behavior;
- repository-grounded answers;
- missing/wrong repository scope;
- numbered source references;
- source-detail metadata, excerpt or immutable permalink.

When possible, include the exact repository acronym, snapshot SHA shown by AtM and whether the issue occurs in a new chat or an already frozen chat.

## First-use help

Before opening an issue, check:

- [README.md](../README.md);
- [docs/USER_INTERFACE_GUIDE.md](../docs/USER_INTERFACE_GUIDE.md);
- [docs/TROUBLESHOOTING.md](../docs/TROUBLESHOOTING.md);
- [docs/DEPENDENCIES_AND_COMPATIBILITY.md](../docs/DEPENDENCIES_AND_COMPATIBILITY.md);
- [docs/MODEL_GUIDE.md](../docs/MODEL_GUIDE.md).

## Development questions

For extension work, read [docs/DEVELOPMENT_GUIDE.md](../docs/DEVELOPMENT_GUIDE.md) and the relevant architecture/acceptance documents before proposing a change.

## Security

Do **not** disclose vulnerability details in a public issue. A repository-local security policy will be added after a private reporting route is explicitly configured.
